inputs.text: Look at these hands. They don’t shake because I’m afraid; they shake because they’ve forgotten how to hold anything lighter than a broadsword. I’ve buried three kings, two empires, and every friend I ever shared a fire with
inputs.instruct: Ancient old male, late 70s, bass-baritone range. Labored breath support—heavy, deliberate inhalations between phrases. The tone is textured with a thick, permanent gravel, though the vowels stay open and resonant, reflecting a lifetime of command. The pitch drops even lower when speaking of the past, vibrating with a weary, subterranean power
